name: chess-bishop
description: A complete chess bishop with a diagonal mitre slit and broad base.
useCase: Choose or identify a bishop in a chess interface.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The full mitre keeps a short diagonal slit above the complete stem and broad open base.

24.reason: The larger bishop retains its complete mitre, diagonal slit, full tapered stem and open base.
